description: Centre-Atlantique : Canalisations TMD - GRTgaz - Projets de SUP1 "Maitrise de l'urbanisation" (surfacique) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Access to data is restricted to authorised persons. This dataset contains the plots of Public Utility Servitudes 1 (SUP1) projects to manage urbanisation, linked to the natural gas transmission pipelines of the GRTgaz carrier. The data shall be provided by the GRTgaz carrier. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Central Atlantic: TMD pipelines — GRTgaz — SUP1 Projects “Urbanisation” (surface)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
